# Tool marks

Recognizable original SVG artwork from the product owners. The geometry and aspect ratios are preserved. At the owner's explicit request, the colors in these local copies are adapted to SIDCO's lime and muted green palette; these are not the products' original brand colors. Tool names remain visible or accessible. Their appearance identifies example software, without a partnership or endorsement claim.

| File | Official source |
| --- | --- |
| `odoo.svg` | [Odoo brand assets](https://www.odoo.com/page/brand-assets), [original SVG](https://odoocdn.com/openerp_website/static/src/img/assets/svg/odoo_logo.svg) |
| `teamleader.svg` | [Teamleader brand downloads](https://www.teamleader.eu/nl-be/brand-downloads), [official brand ZIP](https://go.teamleader.eu/hubfs/_Lot-Testfolder/Brand%20Assets.zip), standalone Teamleader_Icon.svg |
| `teams.svg` | [Microsoft Fluent product icon CDN](https://res.cdn.office.net/files/fabric-cdn-prod_20230815.002/assets/brand-icons/product/svg/teams_48x1.svg) |
| `outlook.svg` | [Microsoft Fluent product icon CDN](https://res.cdn.office.net/files/fabric-cdn-prod_20230815.002/assets/brand-icons/product/svg/outlook_48x1.svg) |

Original assets were obtained on 24 October 2026 for the preceding SIDCO implementation and reused locally. The marks are trademarks of their respective owners.
